title: An Angel's Eye View of Bant

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara cut off from red and black mana, a haven of order, honor and community governed by a caste system and protected by knightly orders and warrior angels.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane split into five shards, of which Bant is one.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara, home of the nacatl leonin.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara where all creatures have etherium in them.

entities.name: The angels of Bant
entities.description: Warrior angels who preside over Bant's battlefields as symbols of peace and justice and who once cast the demons out of the plane.

entities.name: The sigils
entities.description: Medallions of honor and patronage that carry much of Bant's magic, conferring protection, healing and angelic grace.

entities.name: Leotau
entities.description: Semi-intelligent lionlike steeds with hooves like Clydesdales, ridden by many knights of Bant.

entities.name: Rhoxes
entities.description: Humanoid rhino ascetics and warrior-monks of Bant, terse and gruff.

entities.name: Aven
entities.description: Humanoid birds of prey who fill the non-angel flyer role in Bant.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker from Esper with etherium in him; the creative team decided he is not an artifact type.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A nacatl planeswalker from Naya who gave up creaturehood when his brother died and his spark ignited.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: A coastal region of Bant where horse-riders can be found.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: A coastal region of Bant where horse-riders can be found.

entities.name: Eos
entities.description: A savannah interior region of Bant.

events.summary: Ajani gave up creaturehood when his brother died and his spark ignited.
events.quote: Ajani gave up creaturehood when his brother died and his spark ignited

events.summary: The angels cast the demons out of Bant, ending tainted sigils.
events.quote: those went away when the angels cast the demons out of the plane

relations.quote: protected by innumerable knightly orders, warrior angels, and a caste system

relations.note: Bant is a shard of Alara.
relations.quote: It's a shard of Alara where traditions have thrived

relations.note: Leotau are steeds ridden by knights of Bant.
relations.quote: The leotau (LEE-oh-tow, last syllable rhymes with "brow") are the mighty lionlike steeds ridden by many knights of Bant.
